Network Security

Vận chuyển nghiêm ngặt MTA

An email security policy (MTA-STS) that enforces strict encrypted transport (typically via TLS) between Mail Transfer Agents, reducing risk of interception and downgrade attacks during email delivery.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

An email security policy (MTA-STS) that enforces strict encrypted transport (typically via TLS) between Mail Transfer Agents, reducing risk of interception and downgrade attacks during email delivery.

Operational example

MTA strict transport ensures all outbound email from the organization is delivered over TLS, rejecting insecure SMTP connections.
